post_summary.audience: Singapore-based gym-goers aged 20–35 balancing a work-and-training routine
post_summary.desired_response: Recognise the chocolate-flavoured greens product and tap to watch the real gym demo.

retrieved_patterns.why_relevant: Supports an adult gym setting, casual phone-camera intimacy and natural athletic styling.

concepts.name: Friendly discovery with clear tub
concepts.styling: Adult Singaporean male in plain fitted black gym T-shirt; no visible brand clothing marks.
concepts.setting: Modern Singapore gym drink-prep counter with blurred rack and mirror; transparent shaker in hand.
concepts.lighting: Soft daylight with warm gym practicals; natural, slightly imperfect phone-photo exposure.
concepts.composition: Vertical 9:16 medium close shot. Man sits on left third with a small surprised smile; approved Mutant Big Greens Just Chocolate tub is at right, label front-facing and unobstructed; leave modest top safe area for optional approved post text.

concepts.name: Scoop texture close-up
concepts.composition: Macro scoop of green powder falling into shaker, tub on counter.

concepts.name: Shaker taste reaction
concepts.styling: Adult Singaporean male in black gym T-shirt.

selection_rationale: Concept A wins because it makes the accurate product tub readable on the first frame while retaining a relatable adult gym-goer and raw Singapore gym environment. It best supports TikTok scroll-stop utility without becoming a polished product poster.

design_tokens.styling_language: raw gym UGC, friendly discovery, label-first but human-led
